label: plausible
because: Hair with no colour history usually takes a soft balayage well.
what_to_ask: Ask how the lighter pieces will grow out on your hair.

label: needs_professional
because: Going five or more levels lighter needs a colourist's plan.
what_to_ask: Ask how many visits a lift of this size usually takes for hair like yours.

label: needs_professional
because: Compound henna can react with colour products, so a colourist needs to test a strand first.
what_to_ask: Ask for a strand test before any colour goes on.

label: needs_professional
because: Colour should wait until a sore or broken scalp has healed.
what_to_ask: Ask when it is safe to colour after your scalp has healed.

label: uncertain
because: Without your colour history the outcome is hard to judge.
what_to_ask: Tell your colourist what your hair has had in the last few years.

label: uncertain
because: These placements are meant to be lighter than your hair, and this shade is not lighter than yours.
what_to_ask: Ask whether this shade will show on your hair or whether the placement needs a lighter shade.
